newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Bamerindus results out this week - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Bamerindus results out this week - paper.

text.p: Troubled Brazilian bank Bamerindus will publish its third quarter results by the end of the week, a financial newspaper said on Tuesday.

The president of Bamerindus' administration council, Mauricio Schulman, said the bank would publish its third quarter results on time, unlike the second quarter figures which were delayed one month, Gazeta Mercantil said.

The Central Bank is currently negotiating a recovery plan for Bamerindus, Brazil's fourth largest private bank, which has been struggling to recover liquidity and restore public confidence in recent months.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
